claims.content: The Customer wants to complete the transaction for auction items won by choosing which items to pay for, selecting a shipping method, and finalizing the payment type.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Customer wants to complete the transaction for auction items won by choosing which items to pay for, selecting a shipping method, and finalizing the payment type.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Customer, having won auction item(s), enters the checkout/payment flow, chooses the won item(s) to pay for, selects a shipping method, chooses a payment type, and completes the checkout/payment transaction.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Customer is on the won-items payment/checkout page and begins selecting which won items to pay for.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The Customer has selected the item(s) to pay for, chosen a shipping method, selected a payment type, and finalized/submitted the transaction.
in_scope_actions: Choose which won items to pay for
Finalize/submit the checkout and payment transaction
excluded_adjacent_actions: Placing bids or winning auction items
Payment processing back-end or dispute/refund handling
variant_dimensions: Which won item(s) the Customer selects to pay for
